newsitem.title: ITALY: Italy intends to issue long-dated yen Eurobond.
newsitem.headline: Italy intends to issue long-dated yen Eurobond.

text.p: The Republic of Italy intends to issue a long-dated Eurobond denominated in yen, the Italian Treasury said in a statement on Monday.
It said Nomura International would co-ordinate the transaction. It gave no further details.
The Treasury said in March that it planned to issue foreign currency bonds worth between $12-15 billion in 1996.
It has issued dollar, yen and ecu denominated Eurobonds.
The last issue was a five year $1.5 billion Eurobond, launched on September 10.
